title: Madhu — Product Designer
description: Madhumita Krishnan — product designer with a background in architecture and brand strategy. Curious about how design helps our mind process complex workflows.

hero.headline: Hi, I'm Madhu
lines: Architecture taught me how to guide people with design.
Brand strategy taught me to study why they believe in that guidance.
As a product designer I combine both disciplines to help people navigate digital complexity with confidence.

about.title: I love designing experiences that make it easier for people to stay curious
more: What draws me to product design is the same concept that has drawn me to tutoring.
I'm interested in the moments where we lose the learner — when someone is excited to understand something, but along the way, starts questioning whether they can.
There's something comforting about helping people feel understood.
